timeline.text: Every time the bot broke, it just said 'processing error' — no matter what actually failed.
That's exactly how a revoked API key sat unnoticed for four months, from April to August.
The bot just looked like it was having a bad day, over and over.
Now a classifier reads the raw error text before it reaches the user.
Quota, dead key, retired model — three failures that used to look identical, now each names itself on the very first message.
